title: 1988 AMC 8 Problem 17
statement: The shaded area is formed by two intersecting perpendicular rectangles, with dimensions as shown. Its area, in square units, is

answerChoices.label: E
answerChoices.text: unable to be determined from the information given

solutions.text:
The horizontal rectangle has area \(10 \times 2 = 20,\) and the vertical rectangle has area \(3 \times 8 = 24.\) Their overlap, a \(3 \times 2\) rectangle, has area \(6.\)

Adding the two rectangles counts the overlap twice, so the shaded area is \(20 + 24 - 6 = 38.\)

Thus, the correct answer is B .
hints: Add the areas of the two rectangles, but the overlapping region gets counted twice
The horizontal rectangle is \(10 \times 2,\) the vertical one is \(3 \times 8,\) and the overlap is \(3 \times 2\)
